source:
Key to conifers
A. Needles in sheathed bundles ........ Pinus
aa. Needles solitary ........ B
B. Needles on woody pegs ........ Picea
bb. Needles leaving circular scars ........ Abies
why: 字母 B 单独作去向，指第二偶句。A/aa、B/bb 和字母跳转据《Nova Scotia Plants》Pteridophyta 章 Key to ferns and allies；本例另拟性状。https://ojs.library.dal.ca/NSM/article/download/5292/4777
